protocol.label: Development robustness screen — revealed synthetic reference

numerical_settings.rule: Every baseline and achieved prefix/final state must have valid default, half-step and extended-horizon engine runs with matching model, forcing and engine. Require per-node spill convergence within max(0.05 m3, 2% of the larger absolute default/half-step magnitude), extra spill within 0.05 m3 per protected node and total by 360 minutes, and identical protected-node pass/fail at both routing steps. Any missing check, failure or classification flip is unresolved.

limitations: All cases use the same synthetic catchment. H1/H2 have already been revealed; no independent validation or field effectiveness is established.
The parameter values are illustrative engineering sensitivities, not calibrated uncertainty bounds, probabilities or return periods.
Spill is removed at named drainage-model boundaries. It is not mapped street flooding, damage or crew safety.
The hydraulic experiment starts cold. Horizon-sensitive cases fail numerical adequacy; agreement by 360 minutes does not establish field-valid antecedent conditions.
Engine validity, step-halving, doubled-horizon and protected-decision checks are mandatory for each achieved state. Numerical agreement is software evidence, not physical calibration.
Passing this finite set does not guarantee non-worsening between or beyond its members, under wet work, or on another catchment.
Hashes detect stale or altered local evidence; they are not a digital signature, role authentication or independent laboratory attestation.

case.title: Monsoon Rehearsal · synthetic reference catchment
case.description: Two prescribed inflow branches, a shared trunk and online designed storage. Concept verification only; no surveyed site, rainfall forecast, inundation map or calibrated benefit.

jobs.title: Restore shared trunk
jobs.description: Remove lateral encroachment: clear width 0.40 to 1.10 m; same invert, depth and roughness.

jobs.title: Restore Branch A reach
jobs.description: Restore A1 to A2 clear width from 0.35 to 0.80 m; separate asset.

jobs.title: Restore Branch B upstream reach
jobs.description: Restore B1 to B2 clear width from 0.30 to 0.70 m; not the storage inlet.

jobs.title: Restore designed storage inlet
jobs.description: Restore B2 to storage clear width from 0.20 to 0.80 m; designed outlet remains unchanged.

model_assumptions: CMS inflows prescribed at A1 and B1; inlet capture is not modelled.
Conveyance restrictions are synthetic lateral encroachment represented only by clear rectangular width.
All node flooding crosses an absorbing collector boundary; no surface ponding or re-entry.
All maintenance completes dry before the 3-hour hydraulic event; no transient in-work geometry.
Storage has fixed 300 m2 surface area and unchanged 0.5 m circular outlet.
Initial storage depth is observed hydraulic state, not manipulated to justify a job.
No flap gate at outfall; dynamic-wave routing permits reverse flow.
Coordinates are a schematic, not surveyed geospatial positions.

planning_scenarios.title: Balanced design event
planning_scenarios.description: Synthetic symmetric 50-minute triangular inflows; low tailwater; nominal work durations.

planning_scenarios.title: Branch A dominant event
planning_scenarios.description: Synthetic A-dominant triangular inflows; upper-bound durations.

planning_scenarios.title: Branch B dominant event
planning_scenarios.description: Synthetic B-dominant triangular inflows; shorter observed work durations.

planning_scenarios.title: Elevated receiving water
planning_scenarios.description: Elevated fixed tailwater with otherwise balanced inflow. Backflow is allowed.

decision_manifest.screened_states: Every completed prefix plus final state, under the matching planning forcing
decision_manifest.duration_information: Realised durations are read only after dispatch; planning ensemble used to select locked policies
decision_manifest.grid_mean_interpretation: Unweighted mean of declared scenarios; not an expected annual loss

cases.rationale: Recheck the selected frozen queue under its original planning input.

cases.title: Elevated receiving water
cases.rationale: Recheck the selected frozen queue under its original planning input.

cases.title: Revealed H1: double pulse
cases.rationale: Preserve the original hydraulic forcing and durations. Already revealed in v0.1; this is development evidence, not a fresh independent holdout.

cases.title: Revealed H2: initially filled storage
cases.rationale: Preserve the original hydraulic forcing and durations. Already revealed in v0.1; this is development evidence, not a fresh independent holdout.

cases.title: Balanced inflow peaks minus 20%
cases.rationale: A lower input can change where a restoration moves spill. Symmetric 20% flow perturbations probe response direction; they are illustrative sensitivities, not measured error bounds.

cases.title: Balanced inflow peaks plus 20%
cases.rationale: The upper counterpart to the flow perturbation tests increased loading with the same hydrograph shape, timing and branch ratio.

cases.title: Conduit roughness minus 20%
cases.rationale: Uniformly reduced resistance can transfer water downstream faster. The symmetric roughness pair tests a distinct hydraulic sensitivity without changing job geometry.

cases.title: Conduit roughness plus 20%
cases.rationale: Uniformly increased resistance tests reduced conveyance. The range is illustrative and has no field-calibrated probability.

cases.title: Remaining blocked widths reduced by 25%
cases.rationale: A one-sided tighter restriction tests uncertain current condition. Restored widths remain exactly as frozen; no width above the existing reference restriction is invented.

cases.title: Initial storage depth 1.5 m
cases.rationale: A three-quarter-full designed store leaves less attenuation capacity. This prescribed synthetic initial level is within the 2 m model geometry, not a field observation.

cases.title: Fixed receiving stage 100.6 m
cases.rationale: An additional 0.2 m above the existing P4 stage probes downstream control. It is a non-equilibrated cold start and the spill metric is restricted to 180 minutes.

cases.title: All jobs realise their existing duration bounds
cases.rationale: Separate the effect of conservative work completion from hydraulic forcing. Existing dispatch bounds are unchanged; realised times only become available after dispatch.

cases.title: Joint adverse loading and condition corner
cases.rationale: One declared interaction corner combines the upper flow/roughness, tighter restriction, filled store, elevated receiving stage and bounded durations. It is not assumed to be the worst possible combination.

limitations: All cases use the same synthetic catchment. H1/H2 have already been revealed; no independent validation or field effectiveness is established.
The parameter values are illustrative engineering sensitivities, not calibrated uncertainty bounds, probabilities or return periods.
Spill is removed at named drainage-model boundaries. It is not mapped street flooding, damage or crew safety.
The hydraulic experiment starts cold. Horizon-sensitive cases fail numerical adequacy; agreement by 360 minutes does not establish field-valid antecedent conditions.
Engine validity, step-halving, doubled-horizon and protected-decision checks are mandatory for each achieved state. Numerical agreement is software evidence, not physical calibration.
Passing this finite set does not guarantee non-worsening between or beyond its members, under wet work, or on another catchment.
Hashes detect stale or altered local evidence; they are not a digital signature, role authentication or independent laboratory attestation.
selection_statement: A single planning-admissible priority queue was fixed before these callbacks. No ranking, oracle, alternative selection or queue repair used stress outcomes.
